rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a material argumentative template: both memoranda reject a narrowly targeted expansion of government assistance because it would benefit only one segment, divert or dilute limited resources, undermine broader program principles, and impede development of a sound comprehensive solution. Both then contrast the bill with a preferable general reform. C20 and C07 share the veto-memorandum form and organized objections, but their closest common language is more routine and their substantive machinery is less parallel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the provisions of H.R. 6373 would apply to only a small segment of the domestic minerals industry and would not reach the fundamentals of the problem
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A bill such as H.R. 6818, which would affect only one of the public assistance programs ... offers no real solution to the problems of the needy blind.
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the bill as selective relief for one segment that fails to solve the underlying system-wide problem.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this bill would make solution of the overall problems of the industry more difficult
shared_material.parent_excerpt: would also, in the long run, retard a more constructive approach to the attainment of an adequate measure of security
shared_material.explanation: Each argues that the stopgap measure would actively obstruct a more comprehensive future solution.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The interests of the domestic minerals industry will be better served by proceeding with the careful development of a long range minerals program than by approving a stopgap measure extending substantial Government aid to only a segment of the industry.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The most compelling reason for disapproval of this bill is my firm belief that the unsound principle on which it is based would seriously hinder further progress in the development of a sound and comprehensive social security program.
shared_material.explanation: The concluding justification follows the same functional contrast between narrow immediate aid and development of a sound, comprehensive or long-range program.
